# Hidden worker, fired from the options (var oe_nb_job); location, ruler and subject changes stay out of the option previews.
oe_nb.90 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_nb.90.t
    trigger = { tag = BYZ }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_job ?= 11 } oe_nb_job_guy = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_job ?= 21 } oe_nb_job_bride = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_job ?= 51 } oe_nb_job_raid = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_job ?= 71 } oe_nb_job_ports = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_job ?= 91 } oe_nb_job_cairo = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_job ?= 92 } oe_nb_job_withdraw = yes }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nb_job } remove_variable = oe_nb_job }
    }
}
